# VizBiz — AI Visibility Intelligence for Car Dealerships
> VizBiz helps car dealerships measure and improve how often they appear in AI-powered search results like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini. We run real buyer-intent queries against multiple AI platforms, track which dealerships appear, score visibility signals, and deliver prioritized action plans. Free AI visibility audit available.

## What VizBiz Does

VizBiz measures AI visibility for car dealerships. When a buyer asks ChatGPT "What's the best Toyota dealership near me?", someone gets recommended and someone doesn't. VizBiz runs 84 buyer-intent queries across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity to find out if your dealership appears, how you're described, and which competitors are being surfaced instead.

We score dealerships across five categories — Dealer Discovery (30%), Trust & Reviews (25%), Service (20%), Inventory (15%), and Finance (10%) — producing a single AI Visibility Index (AVI) score from 0-100. The average dealership scores below 60.

## Services

### AI Visibility Snapshot (Free)
A quick readout showing whether your dealership appears in AI-driven answers across major platforms. Includes basic scoring, top-level recommendations, and competitor comparison. Takes 24-48 hours. No credit card required.

### AI Visibility Audit (Paid — $299 one-time)
Comprehensive analysis across 84 buyer-intent queries on ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and other AI platforms. Scores your dealership across entity consistency, review depth, content quality, and authority signals. Benchmarks against local competitors. Includes a Revenue Leak Calculator showing profit at risk from poor AI visibility. Delivers a prioritized action plan with specific fixes.

### Ongoing AI Visibility Monitoring (Subscription — $499/month)
Monthly tracking of your AI visibility across platforms. Measures changes over time, alerts you to competitor movements, and updates your action plan as AI models evolve. Includes quarterly re-audits with full 84-query battery.

## Technology
- Queries: ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, and expanding
- Scoring: 84 buyer-intent queries, 252 data points per dealership, five weighted categories
- Dimensions: Entity consistency, review depth, content quality, service signals, authority mentions
- Reporting: Visual dashboards, competitive benchmarks, revenue leak calculator, prioritized action plans
- Tracking: Monthly measurement cadence with trend analysis and competitor alerts
